adjudication.evidence: Original N/E/U shows a sustained negative offset in E and U from ~index 415 to ~469, with interior points (e.g., indices 420–462) consistently displaced (~-12 to -14 in E, ~-10 to -15 in U), followed by a clear return toward pre-offset levels after index 469 (e.g., index 470: [5.15063, 4.8581, 2.72848] vs pre-offset ~[6–8, 4–5, 1–3]). P1 (415–469) aligns with onset and return boundaries supported by observations; P2 (420–462) is nested and less complete. Onset offsets for P1 are large and coherent across axes; P2 offsets are near-zero and inconsistent with observed displacement. Physical motion (e.g., smooth trends within the interval) is preserved. No independent permanent step overlaps the interval. Thus only P1 is genuine.
